name: refactor_kotlin_when_chain_to_polymorphism
description: Refactors an external type-checking when-chain over a sealed class into polymorphic per-subclass area() methods
prompts: Shapes.area(shape: Shape) in src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/Shape.kt computes the area of a Shape (a sealed class with data classes Circle, Rectangle, Triangle) using an external `when (shape) { is Circle -> ...; is Rectangle -> ...; is Triangle -> ... }` chain. Refactor this to polymorphism: give Shape an abstract `fun area(): Double`, and implement it directly in each subclass (Circle, Rectangle, Triangle) with its own formula, removing the external type-switching entirely. Circle's area is pi * radius^2, Rectangle's is width * height, Triangle's is 0.5 * base * height - keep these exact formulas. The Shapes object and its area(shape: Shape): Double function may remain as a thin wrapper that calls shape.area(), or be removed entirely - either way, calling code that computes an area for a Circle/Rectangle/Triangle must still get the same numeric result. The file declares package com.optarena.app.
